name: Azure Health Data Services Vocabulary
description: Controlled vocabulary of terms, acronyms, and domain concepts used across Azure Health Data Services (FHIR, DICOM, MedTech, De-identification).

hasDefinedTerm.name: Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources
hasDefinedTerm.description: HL7 standard for exchanging healthcare information electronically. Azure Health Data Services implements FHIR R4 (version 4.0.1).

hasDefinedTerm.name: Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine
hasDefinedTerm.description: International standard for medical images and related information. Azure implements DICOMweb APIs: STOW-RS (store), QIDO-RS (query), WADO-RS (retrieve).

hasDefinedTerm.name: Internet of Medical Things
hasDefinedTerm.description: Connected medical devices and wearables that stream health telemetry. The MedTech service ingests IoMT data and converts it to FHIR Observations.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Protected Health Information
hasDefinedTerm.description: Individually identifiable health information protected under HIPAA. Azure Health Data Services operates within HIPAA/HITRUST compliance boundaries.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Substitutable Medical Applications, Reusable Technologies on FHIR
hasDefinedTerm.description: Open standard for launching healthcare applications within EHRs. Azure FHIR service supports SMART v1 and v2.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Store Over the Web by RESTful Services
hasDefinedTerm.description: DICOMweb standard for storing DICOM instances via a RESTful HTTP API.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Query based on ID for DICOM Objects by RESTful Services
hasDefinedTerm.description: DICOMweb standard for searching DICOM studies, series, and instances via RESTful HTTP.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Web Access to DICOM Objects by RESTful Services
hasDefinedTerm.description: DICOMweb standard for retrieving DICOM instances and metadata via RESTful HTTP.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Unified Procedure Step RESTful Services
hasDefinedTerm.description: DICOMweb standard for managing imaging workflow steps (worklist). Supported by the Azure DICOM Worklist Service.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Azure Health Data Services Workspace
hasDefinedTerm.description: Top-level Azure resource that groups FHIR, DICOM, and MedTech service instances into a shared HIPAA/HITRUST compliance boundary.

hasDefinedTerm.name: DICOMcast
hasDefinedTerm.description: Azure feature that synchronizes DICOM imaging metadata into the FHIR service as ImagingStudy resources, enabling unified clinical+imaging queries.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Change Feed
hasDefinedTerm.description: Ordered, append-only audit log of all create/update/delete events on DICOM instances. Enables event-driven architectures and compliance auditing.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Electronic Health Record
hasDefinedTerm.description: Digital record of patient health information created, stored, and shared across health organizations.

hasDefinedTerm.name: PHI Tagging Operation
hasDefinedTerm.description: De-identification operation that identifies and labels PHI entity spans in clinical text without modifying the text.

hasDefinedTerm.name: PHI Redaction Operation
hasDefinedTerm.description: De-identification operation that replaces identified PHI spans with their entity type label (e.g., [PATIENT]).

hasDefinedTerm.name: PHI Surrogation Operation
hasDefinedTerm.description: De-identification operation that replaces PHI with realistic pseudonyms, maintaining internal consistency within a batch using a seed value.

hasDefinedTerm.name: HIPAA 18 Safe Harbor Identifiers
hasDefinedTerm.description: The 18 categories of PHI defined by HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification standard. The Azure de-identification service processes all 18 plus additional entity types.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Role-Based Access Control
hasDefinedTerm.description: Authorization model using Microsoft Entra ID to grant access to Azure Health Data Services resources based on assigned roles.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Azure Resource Manager
hasDefinedTerm.description: Azure's control-plane API for provisioning and managing Azure resources including Health Data Services workspaces and service instances.

hasDefinedTerm.name: MedTech Service
hasDefinedTerm.description: Azure Health Data Services managed service (formerly IoT Connector) that ingests device telemetry from Azure Event Hub and maps it to FHIR Observation resources.
